goal.criterion: Complete the existing autonomous operating loop with independently verified session, continuation and actual runtime ownership
goal.rationale: Finish the existing whole-goal acceptance matrix without manual user relay or weaker verification.

plan.objective: Implement ONLY Checklist-complete release verification in SPEC.md. Reuse existing ReleaseRunner ownership, full incumbent/candidate coverage and per-process bounds; durable progress/timeout evidence. Do not run full repository suite; run targeted tests and Ruff, report exact commands honestly. No live state edits, merge, deployment or self-approval.
acceptance_criteria: Both suites use immutable exact collection manifests and bounded serial batches; complete actual node accounting is required before success; no dropped tests or silent policy change.
Timeout/failure/cancel preserves diagnostic evidence and owns process cleanup; failed/unknown checks never become approval and fencing remains intact.
Actual tiny pytest-process tests cover complete/empty/failed collection, parameterized IDs, missing/duplicate/unexpected coverage, skips, timeout logs and compatible existing release behavior.
